nonGoals: No candidate-controlled manifest authenticates its issuer; out-of-band digest alone is integrity, not authority

decisions: Require explicit operator-origin expected manifest/source/tree/artifact/policy; never trust manifest self-pins

Report each claim's raw positive/negative presence and independently authenticated authority as distinct, never producing release authorization

Reject symlink, hard-link alias, missing evidence, digest substitution, wrong negative file or invalid file sizes
Complete raw evidence is never accepted authority or production qualification

impact: New opt-in read-only code only; no changes to existing callers, CI, deployment, grants or release states
